definitions.explanation: Material used to build or finish walls — for example plaster, plasterboard, tile, or wood paneling. Built from {壁|かべ} (wall) + {材|ざい} (material).

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}な{壁材|かべざい}を{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: We chose a natural wall material.

examples.japanese: この{壁材|かべざい}は{湿気|しっけ}に{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: This wall material is resistant to moisture.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}は、{選|えら}ぶ{壁材|かべざい}によって{大|おお}きく{変|か}わる。
examples.english: A room's atmosphere changes greatly depending on the wall material you choose.

notes:
A construction and interior-design term for any material that makes up or covers a wall.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壁材|かべざい}を{選|えら}ぶ: to choose a wall material
- {内装|ないそう}{壁材|かべざい}: interior wall material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {床材|ゆかざい}: flooring material — the parallel '{...}{材|ざい}' term for floors
- {建材|けんざい}: building material — the broad category covering all construction materials
